name: evidence-recovery-ux
title: Make stale verificationEvidence recovery a one-step visible flow
description: B-c9f5 dirty gate loops included a hidden second failure: after main was merged into the story branch, existing verificationEvidence went stale via materialHash drift, but the user-facing output looked like a generic validation failure. The recovery is mechanical (verification_evidence_refresh_stale + revalidate), so the gap is pure UX. Detect stale state at session_brief / story_advance / koala validate boundaries, print the literal recovery commands as copy-paste lines including the current storyId, and add a single-shot recover_evidence command that runs refresh + revalidate and refuses when non-metadata dirt exists. The story does not auto-recover without user action — only makes the next step unambiguous.
